title: Declared Synthetic Subscription Contract Evidence
pii_phi_handling: Synthetic, PHI-free and PII-free reference scenario. No real documents, transactions, signatures, approvals or supplier communications.
notes: Declaration only; not load approval. Uses a declared canonical contract/source-record and native application-scope binding, fixed reporting cutoff, explicit engineering archetype and versioned synthetic assumptions. Application and system namespaces are not equated; no service identity is inferred from an application reference. Terms remain not_reviewed, candidate opportunity amounts remain unsized, and diagnostic ratios are not savings. Exact delegated load candidate, before-image proof, load quality gates and cite-render proof are required separately. No real ERP, ITSM or document-repository connection is asserted.
